review.name: Worth every penny
review.reviewBody: Look this product is great for its price, and works perfectly. And for the food ,i tried french fries and it was pretty much great without oil + you can do much more with the air fryer like baking grilling etc. So definitely worth buying. Go for it

review.name: Terrific
review.reviewBody: Absolute gem of a product. This has been the most used product in my kitchen ever since I bought it a couple of months back. Lost count of how many packets of fries, wedges, pizza pockets, mini samosa, aloo tikki, nuggets and so on which I have fried in this without a single drop of oil. Does it's job superbly well. The size being 2 liters don't expect a full cook if you load the pan half full or more. You will need to shuffle the food inside a couple of times and run for 30 mins or so, but if you load items such that they are not stacked over each other - it goes a great job within 15 to 18 minutes per round. All in all, a great product and worth every penny!
